epistemic_status: NO novelty verified for any kept idea. Every prior-art statement in kill reasons and watchlists is this judge's unverified assessment, labeled as such. No citations were invented; the three generator shards contain zero citation-like strings (checked by pattern scan), and all 302 records carry the full 13-field schema with [HYPOTHESIS]/[MODEL SPECULATION] hedges intact.
method: Pass 1 hygiene: all 302 records checked for the 13-field schema (present, uniform); pattern scan for fabricated citations (none found); hedging spot-checks on kill candidates and high-risk keeps.

Pass 2 mode-collapse attack per shard: repeated idea-shapes extracted (D: naming-vs-finding restated 4x, bootstrap-noise 2x, context-reliance 4x; E: shortcut-solvable referring audits 3x, consistency-signals 3x; F: realism-is-not-the-active-ingredient 13x, cheap-predictor-of-outcome 7x, scaling-law-fits 4x).

Pass 3 cross-shard template extraction: 28 named template families; closest same-hypothesis pairs merged to a single primary; family membership flagged on survivors rather than merged when experimental designs genuinely differ.

Pass 4 architecture/task permutation attack: detection<->segmentation<->dense<->MLLM ports of one hypothesis merged (e.g., part-queries-return-wholes, boundary-weighted eval, distractor-vocabulary collapse); ports of PUBLISHED results killed (typographic attacks, register tokens, accumulate-vs-replace collapse).
Pass 5 wave1 collision audit: all 302 one-liners compared against the 248 accepted wave1 ideas; 17 merges into wave1 master ids (prefix 'wave1:'), plus adjacency flags on keeps.

Pass 6 anomaly protection: 33 non-template, contrarian, or tension-bearing ideas explicitly protected from consolidation pressure; 8 deliberate tensions preserved as experiment-adjudicable disagreements.

Merge rule (inherited from wave1 judge C): two ideas merge only when they assert the same mechanism testable by one experimental design; substrate/task/architecture permutations do not count as distinct hypotheses.

kill_reasons.W13-P1-D-059: Typographic attacks on contrastive image-text models are established at image level (judge-assessed, UNVERIFIED prior art), and open-vocabulary detectors reuse those encoders, so region-level transfer is an expected-yes substrate permutation, not a belief challenge. The stated community default ('region scores reflect in-region appearance evidence') is not genuinely held for CLIP-derived detectors; wave1's accepted set already treats out-of-region and text leakage as live phenomena (C-090 family), and this wave's D-062/D-010 family covers out-of-region evidence reliance. Residual content (spatial footprint mapping, marker-pen physical realizability) is measurement detail. Wave1 precedent: the mirrored idea A-077 (typographic immunity of coordinate prompts) was unanimously killed as following from the interface definition.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-E-035: Restates the documented high-norm outlier/register-token result for large-scale ViTs (judge-assessed, UNVERIFIED prior art) whose published form already demonstrates that these tokens carry global rather than local content, that they tax dense prediction, and that removing or re-housing them helps. The community_default_belief field ('patch tokens trusted as spatially faithful') is precisely the belief that literature already overturned, so no live belief is attacked. Residual content (a prevalence census in contrastive VLMs and a training-free reassignment A/B) is characterization of a known artifact. This is also the third across-wave instantiation of the outlier-token template (wave1 A-039 was kept for its distinct SAM mask-leakage linkage). Divergence note: wave2 Judge A kept E-035 while flagging it their highest prior-art risk; this judge concludes kill.
kill_reasons.W13-P1-F-053: Restates the accumulate-vs-replace boundary condition of model collapse, which is (judge-assessed, UNVERIFIED) a prominently published and widely discussed result; its community_default_belief field ('collapse cited as a general property rather than regime-specific') is a strawman after that literature. Residual content (vision-specific multi-generation grid with dense-task endpoints and anchor-fraction boundary mapping) is an ablation of a known claim, not a new hypothesis. Independent convergence: wave2 Judge A also killed F-053 on the same ground. Consolidator may resurrect if the novelty gate disagrees with the prior-art assessment.

anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-028: Size priming: within-class co-occurrence gating small-object recall is not a template member; no other idea predicts detection conditioned on same-class scale context.

anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-030: Generative super-resolution dragging tiny-object labels toward typical categories: a preprocessing-induced semantic bias claim nobody else makes.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-044: Anti-thesis to the shard's own naming-vs-finding consensus: objectness transfer, not naming, bottlenecks unusual-shaped rare objects. Protected as deliberate tension with D-071.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-046: Segmentation-first detection for irregular objects inverts the standard pipeline direction; benchmark shape statistics hiding it is a concrete confound claim.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-050: Mask-derived box targets improving box AP itself is a supervision-geometry claim running against the multitask framing; cheap and decisive.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-053: Thing-stuff ontology as load-bearing arbitrary choice attacks panoptic evaluation at the ontology level rather than the metric level.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-066: Tokenizer priors visible in generated box coordinates (round numbers, canonical aspect ratios) is an output-distribution artifact unique to autoregressive interfaces.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-072: Where/what feature incompatibility (two-stream frozen readout beating single features) contradicts both the shared-backbone default and this shard's recognition-only story. Protected tension.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-082: Count labels as cheap detection supervision unlocks a data source (inventory metadata) no other idea touches.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-083: Detector-regressor disagreement as a free annotation-error audit turns a nuisance (method disagreement) into an instrument.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-D-097: Models out-localizing their own training labels (closer to consensus than single-annotator GT) implies evaluation penalizes correctness; sharpest annotation-noise claim in the shard.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-009: Training-free retrieval-based dense labeling as a rival to learned heads is a non-parametric contrarian baseline, not an audit template.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-022: Round-trip self-consistency (comprehend your own generated expression) is a self-communication probe no benchmark currently runs.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-055: Frame-of-reference ambiguity resolved silently viewer-centric, with annotators sharing the bias, claims a hidden agreement artifact between models and ground truth.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-058: Monocular-depth injection disproportionately repairing depth-dependent relations is a clean causal-attribution design, not a permutation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-084: Grammar-to-topology coupling (mass vs count phrasing switching merged vs instance masks) is an unmeasured linguistic-structural effect; kept despite wave1 B-030 adjacency because topology switching differs from grounding-quality differences.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-085: Ordinal reference failing for want of an explicit sort, with off-by-adjacency error structure, is an architectural-computation-gap claim with a distinctive predicted error signature.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-087: Complement queries failing despite being trivially computable from the affirmative mask isolates a set-operation gap with zero perceptual excuse.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-090: Conjunction/disjunction indistinguishability (cats and dogs vs cats or dogs) is a logical-connective claim distinct from negation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-095: Chain-of-thought actively harming mask grounding via attention displacement runs against the more-reasoning-is-better default.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-E-099: Visual prompt overlays contaminating predictions for unmarked objects is an interference effect mark-based prompting studies never control.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-007: Synthetic-data value predicted by real-label acquisition cost rather than domain gap is an economics-first claim orthogonal to the shard's realism templates.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-009: Uniform-over-kinematic-space pose sampling beating realistic mocap distributions is an anti-realism sampling claim with a specific counterintuitive direction.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-043: Curating real web data to match a synthetic reference reverses the standard curation direction; nobody else inverts the arrow.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-060: Generator-fingerprint recovery from student behavior enables training-data supply-chain forensics; an application claim unique in the pool.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-076: Synthetic-only-supervised tasks (intrinsic decomposition) possibly learning renderer conventions rather than physics attacks a task's epistemic foundation, not its methods.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-080: Uncanny-valley non-monotonicity for rendered humans (mid-realism worst) is a non-monotone transfer claim; every template in the family assumes monotone axes.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-089: Batch-generation i.i.d. violation via shared seeds/prompts/scheduler state is an overlooked statistical mechanism with a free mitigation.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-091: Realism re-importing the real world's spurious correlations past a threshold is the anti-thesis of the realism-helps default and of naive domain randomization. Protected tension.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-093: Privacy leakage through generator memorization in 'privacy-safe by construction' synthetic data, and the unknown utility cost of verified non-memorization.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-096: Students exceeding the labeling teacher for dense geometry via multi-view/sample averaging is the anti-thesis of F-052's ceiling. Protected tension.
anomaly_notes.W13-P1-F-102: Dataset half-life / depreciation-rate asymmetry between synthetic and real data introduces an amortization-economics variable nobody measures.

deliberate_tensions_kept.note: Recognition-is-the-only-bottleneck (D-071) vs objectness-transfer bottleneck for unusual shapes (D-044) vs where/what feature incompatibility (D-072). Adjudicate by experiment, not dedup.
Student cannot exceed generator-teacher (F-052) vs students surpass teachers on dense geometry via averaging (F-096).
Copy-paste gains partly compositing-artifact learning (D-039) vs blending quality is an over-optimized axis (F-005). Opposite signs on the same knob.
More synthetic diversity keeps paying (F-073, absorbing F-074) vs realism past a threshold re-imports spurious correlations (F-091).
Dense alignment is a shallow learnable transform over frozen features (E-074) vs layer structure fundamentally constrains dense alignment (E-046, absorbing E-001).
Photorealism is obsolete with frozen foundation features (F-017) vs low-level renderer statistics still load-bearing shortcuts (F-019).
Fix the small-object metric (D-018) vs strict metrics already operate beyond the annotation noise floor (D-096). Complementary critiques, kept separate deliberately.
Small specialized generators beat giant generators as data engines (F-100) vs generator-knowledge ceiling framing (F-052).
